# `console/ui/evidence.js`

[As built](../../../README.md) › [Packet review components](../../../subsystems/packet-review-components.md) › `evidence.js`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Two Preact components for displaying evidence in a test/QA system: `Evidence` shows what proves an individual acceptance criterion with provenance and limitations; `RunEvidence` shows all evidence from a test run including recordings, gate results, blind tests, breaker probes, and found issues.

864 lines, in Packet review components.

## Terms

evidence — proof that a criterion holds, acceptance criterion — a feature requirement, gate — an automated check that passes or fails, breaker probe — test designed to find defects, blind test — acceptance test written before implementation, recording or trace — playable browser test execution
